findings: Adding O_NONBLOCK to the existing O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW open is the correct Linux fix: a no-writer FIFO blocked in openSync before fstat could reject a non-regular file, and before any CLI timer existed.

Regular-file success path is unchanged: O_NONBLOCK is ignored for local regular files; isFile, mode 077, uid, and size checks remain on the opened fd; readFileSync still runs only after that conjunction.
FIFO with or without a writer still fails LAUNCH_PRIVATE_FILE (S_IFIFO is not a regular file; st_size is 0). The no-writer hang was the only production gap in scope.

API+CLI spawnSync regression with timeout/SIGKILL is the right hang detector; claimed red ETIMEDOUT / green 12-pass is consistent with this patch. `h` is out of fragment but does not affect the FIFO-open assertion.
